title: Recognizing-an-agent-as-holding-office (positing-regime stance-commitment morphism; κ = ω)
description: Regime: scott-continuous-posit-category (positing morphism, κ = ω). Recognition IS the act of committing a stance — the recognizer commits to 'this agent holds this office' and the agential-relations-system records the commitment. Per lab/.../agentic-systems/library/leader/library/leader-of-a-swarm/doing/working/recognizing-a-character-as-leader-of-a-swarm/_index.md (with 'character' → 'agent' per stabilized grammar): recognition's substrate-effect is operation-kind: mutation. The morphism's act-class is positing (committing-a-stance is the canonical positing-regime morphism); its substrate-effect classification (when projected into the seven operation-kinds) is mutation. The closure converges at exactly ω as the recognition propagates through the agential-relations-system to all participants — Scott-continuous because directed suprema commute (a recognition by participant A and an independent recognition by participant B compose as the supremum of their effects). Per lab's threshold pattern: 'the role's standing is the aggregate count of recognition files for the subject; today the threshold is one (any single recognition activates the role).' Lab uses doing/working/ wrapping (pre-stabilization grammar); current grammar drops it.
